purpose: Determine minimal left stair integration after cross-clip location matching, separating established topology from unknown coordinates/dimensions.
scope: Read-only. No UE calls; no source model/project edits. This report is not an assertion that the original school has the old 6m-wide tower dimensions.

established_corrections.basis: Video 02 3.2/3.6 and video 05 56.0/56.5 share the old cross-wing with pink lower wall, tall openings, small square vent, green-bordered banners and one upper white-walled level.
established_corrections.conclusion: The distant stair in the opening corridor sequence belongs to the teaching building left junction beside that cross-wing.
established_corrections.scope: Relative building junction only; no surveyed position or numbered starting floor.

established_corrections.basis: At 02@3.6 the classroom facade is on the viewer right and the parapet/court on the left; the visible stair is at the end, with rising treads toward image right.
established_corrections.conclusion: In current teaching-local coordinates the approach runs along -u, then turns toward +v into the teaching interior.
established_corrections.scope: Do not place a straight stair descending off the corridor end in -u, or use the opposite right stair by mirroring it blindly.

established_corrections.basis: The floor is visibly continuous toward the distant stair; no doorway leaf or fixed waist-high barrier is visible across that approach.
established_corrections.conclusion: A finished reconstruction needs a continuous turning landing from the corridor end to the first tread.
established_corrections.scope: The clip does not reveal exact landing perimeter, length, depth or left-edge protection. It does not authorize an invented doorway or guardrail.

established_corrections.basis: 05@56 is a courtyard view of the junction; the pink staircase earlier in video 05 belongs to its own old-wing sequence.
established_corrections.conclusion: Do not move the old pink staircase into the teaching stair position.
established_corrections.scope: Exterior adjacency does not establish a traversable indoor connection between the two buildings.

current_model_attachment.coordinate_units: teaching-local metres before wing()/site(); UE values in centimetres
current_model_attachment.landing_must_connect_to: The vertical side face at u=51 of the existing floor mesh, with walking top at h=3.5*f. The actual floor patch can be a new asset; there is no need to modify the full 46m corridor mesh.
current_model_attachment.approach_not_currently_covered: At every upper floor the rectangular area u<51 and v=30.8..33 lies beyond the current corridor slab. There is no existing platform there in the audited source.
current_model_attachment.important_boundary_error_to_avoid: Existing invisible gate at (49,33.05) is a policy blocker, not a measured entrance. The old shaft centre (49,38) also is not the entrance. Neither may be used as a photogrammetric alignment point.
current_model_attachment.geometry_unoccupied_upper_shaft: No internal floor slabs remain in the current shaft. Adding a limited confirmed segment therefore does not require deleting floors to create a stairwell void.
current_model_attachment.no_classroom_edits_required: A staircase/landing staying on the left of u=51.88 does not require cutting the first retained classroom wall at u=51.91..52.09; observed evidence does not authorize classroom edits.

actual_entrance_vs_old_shell_center.actual_entrance_topology_confirmed: At the left end of the teaching corridor, before turning right into the rising flight.

old_first_riser_line_m.warning: Deleted previous invented staircase, not video-derived.

actual_entrance_vs_old_shell_center.why_distinction_matters: Placing a new flight at the old v=36.5 start leaves an unsupported approach gap. Filling that with the old 6x4m connector would quietly reuse unverified dimensions. Conversely centering a new door at (49,33.05) models a doorway that is not seen in the distant clip.

unknowns_that_still_control_final_mesh: Exact visible starting corridor floor (likely 1/F by exterior-level comparison, not a readable sign).
Direct continuity from the distant left-end stair at 3.6s to close-up terrazzo flights at 13-25s; root is inspecting intervening original frames.
The u coordinate of the far end wall and centre/width of each flight.
The v coordinate of the first tread, landing depth and total run.
Riser count and riser height for every hidden or occluded flight.
Extent and handedness of the repeated arrangement at G and upper levels.
Actual relationship between old cross-wing elevations and teaching levels; current model uses different 4.2m and 3.5m storey spacings.

minimal_partial_build_feasibility.feasible_after_missing_registration: A dedicated corridor-end turning platform and the observed +v ascending flight can be added as isolated assets, with only the matching left boundary altered. Add return flight only when its same-stair connection is demonstrated.
minimal_partial_build_feasibility.preserve_shell_caution: Preserving the current shell is a scope constraint, not a demand to fill its full 5.76m clear width or 9m depth. If eventual video proportions contradict it, flag that conflict instead of stretching the observed stair to fit.
